effects.effect:
Your training and faith let you specialize in magic that buffs your allies, debuffs your foes, and allows you to hold your own in combat alongside your friends.

##### Signature Abilities

Choose two [signature abilities](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/signature-ability) from the following options. [Signature abilities](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/signature-ability) can be used at will. (*Quick Build:* [Blessed Light](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.conduit.level-1/blessed-light), [Staggering Curse](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.conduit.level-1/staggering-curse).)

##### Heroic Abilities

You make use of a number of [heroic abilities](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.general/heroic-ability), all of which channel piety to empower them.

###### 3-Piety Ability

Choose one [heroic ability](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.general/heroic-ability) from the following options, each of which costs 3 piety to use. (*Quick Build:* [Violence Will Not Aid Thee](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.conduit.level-1/violence-will-not-aid-thee).)

###### 5-Piety Ability

Choose one [heroic ability](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.general/heroic-ability) from the following options, each of which costs 5 piety to use. (*Quick Build:* [Curse of Terror](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.conduit.level-1/curse-of-terror).)
